requirements: Is there exactly one single object filling the image edge to edge?
Is the object a round-topped red wooden door with two long gold hinges and a gold ring knocker set in a pale stone arch?
Is the door swung open inward about halfway?
Is a warm golden lit hallway visible inside the open doorway with a hint of a coat hook and a rug?
Are there no three stone steps visible below the door?
Is the pale stone arch touching the top and both sides of the image?
Is the door sill touching the bottom of the image?
Is the image centered with the object fully inside and with a clear margin around it?
Are the edges of the object crisp and clean?
Is there no note on the door?
